For an **independent upper-upscale hotel in North America**, the initial conversion/affiliation RFP usually centers on the following brands.

### Core soft-brand candidates

| Brand | Parent | Typical fit |
|---|---|---|
| **Autograph Collection** | Marriott | Often the leading candidate for distinctive, full-service urban hotels and resorts with a strong identity. |
| **Curio Collection** | Hilton | Broad upper-upscale lifestyle collection; particularly relevant when Hilton Honors penetration is important. |
| **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt** | Hyatt | Story-driven upper-upscale and luxury properties, especially landmark or highly differentiated hotels. |
| **Tribute Portfolio** | Marriott | Generally lifestyle-oriented and somewhat more flexible or accessible than Autograph. |
| **JdV by Hyatt** | Hyatt | Smaller, neighborhood-oriented boutique and lifestyle hotels; Hyatt classifies it as upper-upscale. |
| **Destination by Hyatt** | Hyatt | Particularly relevant for destination resorts, golf, ski, beach and experiential properties. |

Marriott explicitly positions Autograph and Tribute as collection models for independent hotels, while Hyatt identifies Unbound and Destination as upper-upscale/luxury independent collections. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands/premium-brands?utm_source=openai)) Hilton describes Curio and Tapestry as conversion-friendly frameworks that preserve individual identity, although Tapestry generally sits below the core upper-upscale target. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hiltons-curio-and-tapestry-collections-celebrate-200th-hotel-milestones?utm_source=openai))

### Other credible alternatives

- **Vignette Collection — IHG:** Best suited to a property reaching toward luxury, with distinctive design, service and food-and-beverage programming. ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/news-and-media/news-releases/2025/ihg-hotels-and-resorts-conversion-friendly-brands-fuel-growth-opportunities-for-owners?utm_source=openai))
- **MGallery Hotel Collection — Accor:** An established upper-upscale collection brand and a logical candidate where Accor’s comparatively smaller North American system is commercially viable. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/news-stories/collection-brands-handwritten-emblems-mgallery?utm_source=openai))
- **Registry Collection Hotels — Wyndham:** Wyndham’s soft-brand upper-upscale/luxury option, aimed primarily at distinctive urban and resort assets. ([development.wyndhamhotels.com](https://development.wyndhamhotels.com/brand/registry-collection-hotels/?utm_source=openai))
- **Radisson Individuals — Choice:** An upper-upscale collection option for an independent hotel; **Radisson Blu** may also be considered if the owner is willing to adopt a harder brand identity. ([choicehotelsdevelopment.com](https://www.choicehotelsdevelopment.com/sfsites/c/cms/delivery/media/MCYWP5VQ7LDFG4FM3V2OE6WF3SOM?utm_source=openai))
- **Preferred Hotels & Resorts:** Not a conventional franchise conversion, but frequently evaluated when the owner wants distribution, sales and loyalty support while retaining greater operational and brand independence. ([join.preferredhotels.com](https://join.preferredhotels.com/?utm_source=openai))
- **Design Hotels:** A selective, design-led affiliation alternative within the Marriott ecosystem; member hotels remain independently owned and operated, and the model is an affiliation rather than a standard franchise. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/ResourceFiles/fdd-document/2025-autograph-collection-fdd-3-31-2025.pdf?utm_source=openai))

### Hard-brand conversion alternatives

If retaining the independent name is less important, an owner may also solicit:

- **Marriott:** Renaissance, Delta Hotels  
- **Hilton:** Hilton Hotels & Resorts, DoubleTree  
- **Hyatt:** Hyatt Regency, Hyatt Centric  
- **IHG:** voco, Hotel Indigo, Crowne Plaza—and occasionally Kimpton  
- **Wyndham:** Wyndham Grand  
- **Choice:** Radisson Blu or Radisson  
- **Sonesta:** The Royal Sonesta or The James  

The Royal Sonesta, for example, is explicitly positioned as conversion-friendly and upper-upscale. ([franchise.sonesta.com](https://franchise.sonesta.com/brands/the-royal-sonesta/?utm_source=openai))

### Practical shortlist

For a typical full-service upper-upscale urban hotel, I would expect the first-round list to be:

1. **Autograph Collection**
2. **Curio Collection**
3. **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt**
4. **Tribute Portfolio**
5. **JdV by Hyatt**
6. **Vignette Collection**

For a resort, add **Destination by Hyatt**, **Registry Collection** and possibly **Preferred Hotels & Resorts**. For a property at the lower edge of upper-upscale—or with limited services—**Tapestry Collection, voco, Radisson Individuals** or certain upscale collection brands may prove more realistic.

As of **August 14, 2026**, IHG’s newly launched **Noted Collection** is designed for upscale-to-upper-upscale conversions, but its rollout began in Europe, the Middle East, Asia and Africa, so it is not yet a standard North American shortlist candidate. ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/~/media/Files/I/Ihg-Plc/results/2026/full-year-2025/ihg-hotels-and-resorts-unveils-new-premium-collection-brand-noted-collection.pdf))
